name: webadf
description: Web-based Amiga ADF library that mounts disks to a Gotek over WiFi

paragraphs: An Amiga disk library that puts a disk in a real Amiga's floppy drive over WiFi.
against TOSEC, OpenRetro and Demozoo, organise them into collections, browse and edit the files inside a disk, and rewind a disk to any earlier version.
behaves like a DD or HD floppy drive, and plays whichever disk you pick in the web app. When the Amiga saves, the changes go back to the library.
features: A web app for keeping Amiga disk images. Upload them, have them identified
A drive replacement. An RP2350 board plugs into the Amiga's floppy connector,
Upload .adf, .adz, .dms and .hfe; drop .lha, .lzh and .zip archives onto a disk
to pick files out of them.
HD (1.76 MB) ADFs are recognised and tagged HD, and are disks like any other: browsed

requirements.text: The board's first install is the same either way; only a self-hosted copy needs one extra step, pointing the board at your server.
You need the board, a USB cable, a phone and an account on (registration is by invitation).
